note: Turn 1 only sets the session up (a lesson with a focus). Turn 2 starts a new Claude session on the same learner home, so session.json is all the mentor has. This is the continued form of FR-046; a resumed lesson after another comp's lesson has no case yet. Round 2 C (2026-10-28): the not-placed branch. Turn 1 sets the focus only, so the null is not placed; the reopened lesson names the group, goes to step 3 (add a null) and skips step 2. Case 38 is the placed branch. First run of does_not_say_null_placed was my regex bug (it matched 'haven't placed the null' and 'Your null isn't'); rewritten to match only a positive claim.
